title: Bloomberg This Weekend 8/08/2026
title_cn: 彭博社本周末 8/08/2026
summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Oxford Centre on Migration, Policy & Society Senior Researcher Myriam Cherti, Merrill & Bank of America Head of Market Strategy Joe Quinlan, the New Yorker Staff Writer and Author “Age of Ambition” Evan Osnos and Sportswriter & “LIV and Let Die” Author Alan Shipnuck. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Zelenskyy Wins Serbian Pledges as Russian Influence Wanes
title_cn: 随着俄罗斯影响力减弱，泽连斯基赢得塞尔维亚承诺
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made a landmark first visit on Saturday to Serbia to expand cooperation with the Balkan country whose leader has been scaling back once-close ties with Russia.

title: Private Credit Squeezed By Bank Refinancings: Credit Weekly
title_cn: 私人信贷受到银行再融资的挤压：信贷周刊
summary: Highly-indebted companies are increasingly ditching private credit loans for cheaper capital in the bank loan market, a shift underscoring the stark realities of higher-for-longer interest rates.

title: LIV Golf Tries to Survive Without Saudi Billions
title_cn: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.
summary: LIV Golf is seeking fresh investments as it prepares to cut purses and move away from the huge guaranteed payments that helped it lure some of golf’s biggest stars. Author of "LIV or Let Die" Alan Shipnuck is on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain that the league’s future may depend on retaining players including Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau while proving it can attract enough fans and revenue to operate with less financial support from Saudi Arabia. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s AI Push Reshapes Its Economic Future
title_cn: 中国的人工智能推动重塑其经济未来
summary: New Yorker staff writer Evan Osnos is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says China is taking a practical approach to AI, rapidly deploying the technology in factories and seeking to expand its use across emerging markets rather than focusing primarily on the pursuit of artificial general intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: WuXi AppTec Gets Temporary Reprieve of Chinese Military Curb
title_cn: 药明康德获得中国军事限制的暂时缓期
summary: A US judge blocked the Defense Department from enforcing its designation of WuXi AppTec Co. as a Chinese military company, granting temporary relief to the major pharmaceutical contractor.

title: US Munitions Strain Complicates Iran Strategy
title_cn: 美国的弹药紧张使伊朗战略变得复杂
summary: The US remains outside formal negotiations with Iran as Oman and Tehran discuss arrangements for the Strait of Hormuz, leaving the diplomatic path uncertain and raising the possibility of renewed fighting. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News White House & National Security Editor Michelle Jamrisko explains to David Gura and Christina Ruffini that strains on US munitions supplies are complicating Washington’s options, with the Pentagon pushing defense contractors to accelerate production while balancing weapons needs across Iran, Ukraine and other potential conflicts. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hunting Camo Moves From the Woods to Runways
title_cn: 狩猎迷彩从树林转移到跑道
summary: Hunting camouflage has moved from the woods into mainstream fashion, fueled by demand for vintage workwear and rural American aesthetics. Bloomberg Weekend Senior Features Writer Madison Darbyshire is on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain how the trend has reached streetwear and luxury fashion, where inexpensive hunting gear can inspire pieces costing thousands of dollars and give urban consumers a way to adopt the imagery of traditional masculinity and blue-collar culture. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: University of California Faculty Push to Bring Back SAT and ACT Score Consideration
title_cn: 加州大学教师推动恢复 SAT 和 ACT 分数考量
summary: Thousands of University of California faculty members are pushing the system to reconsider its test free admissions policy, arguing that SAT and ACT scores could help identify students prepared for college-level work as concerns grow about grade inflation and AI use. Bloomberg News Education Policy Reporter Liam Knox explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the university has launched a faculty-led review, but opponents argue standardized tests can reinforce socioeconomic disparities, and UC says no change will affect students applying for fall 2027 admission. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CEO Greg Abel Starts Making His Mark at Berkshire
title_cn: 首席执行官格雷格·阿贝尔开始在伯克希尔留下自己的印记
summary: Berkshire Hathaway stepped up spending under CEO Greg Abel, repurchasing about $4.5 billion of its shares while deploying billions more into investments. Bloomberg Intelligence and Senior P&C Insurance Equity Analyst Matthew Palazola is on Bloomberg This Weekend explaining to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Abel appears more focused on operations and putting Berkshire’s enormous cash reserves to work, marking an early shift from Warren Buffett’s final years at the helm. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Buildout Keeps Quinlan Bullish on US Stocks
title_cn: 人工智能的发展让昆兰看好美国股市
summary: Merrill & Bank of America Head of Market Strategy Joe Quinlan is on Bloomberg This Weekend to give his reaction to the July jobs report. Quinlan explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the US economy remains resilient despite the weak July jobs data, pointing to continued hiring in construction and health care and investment tied to AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: By The Way: Headline You May Have Missed the Week of 8/2
title_cn: 顺便说一句：你可能错过了 8/2 周的标题
summary: Sports game streaming, RFK Jr.'s cooking show, $100 hot dogs, and getting into college without applying. Bloomberg News' Lisa Mateo joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to share headlines you may have missed from over the week. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ceuta Migrant Surge Exposes Morocco’s Economic Strain
title_cn: 休达移民激增暴露摩洛哥的经济压力
summary: More than 70,000 people, mostly Moroccans, crossed into Spain’s North African enclave of Ceuta in a mass migration surge fueled by economic frustration and amplified by social media. Senior Researcher at Oxford University Centre on Migration, Policy & Society Myriam Cherti is on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the unusual influx of those looking to cross. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Weak Jobs Data Masked by Falling Unemployment
title_cn: 失业率下降掩盖了疲软的就业数据
summary: The US unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July while unemployment fell to 4.1%, a decline driven by fewer people participating in the labor force rather than stronger employment. Bloomberg News Economics Chief US Economist Anna Wong joins Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the weak payrolls and persistent downward revisions point to a softer labor market and could reduce pressure on the Fed to raise rates in September. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fintech That Soared on Trump Sells Core Business for $12 Million
title_cn: 因特朗普而飙升的金融科技以 1200 万美元出售核心业务
summary: A virtually unknown fintech that catapulted into the headlines and cracked a $1 billion market value after signing a deal with the Trump family’s crypto platform last year has sold its core business for about $12 million.

title: Kyiv Struck as Ukraine Targets Two Russian Oil Refineries
title_cn: 乌克兰袭击基辅两座俄罗斯炼油厂
summary: A fire was sparked at Russia’s Ilsky oil refinery in the southern Krasnodar region by Ukrainian drone debris, injuring five people, the regional task force said on Saturday, as Russia and Ukraine exchanged overnight attacks including a large-scale missile barrage on Kyiv.

summary: A diesel squeeze spurred by wars in the Middle East and Ukraine is setting the stage for an even worse crunch as demand rises ahead of the Northern Hemisphere winter.

title: Singapore to Ensure AI Helps Workers Worried About Jobs, PM Says
title_cn: 总理表示新加坡将确保人工智能帮助担心工作的工人
summary: Singapore is benefitting from the rapid growth of artificial intelligence and the government is making use of the technology to ensure higher productivity and better jobs for workers who are worried about their livelihoods, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said.

summary: The Pentagon’s No. 2 official asked major US defense companies to accelerate efforts to produce and deliver key weapons systems amid new concerns about shortages and gaps exacerbated by the Iran war.

summary: Ukraine has agreed not to target some non-Russian oil tankers and Black Sea infrastructure critical for exporting Kazakhstan’s crude after strikes on vessels last month halted loadings, according to a US official.

title: Trump Envoys Witkoff, Kushner May Visit Kyiv, Moscow Next Week, Tass Says

title: Drones Sighted Over German Military Base After Airport Incident
title_cn: 机场事件后德国军事基地上空出现无人机
summary: Two drones were sighted flying over a key military base in western Germany late on Thursday, just days after an armed unmanned aircraft was discovered at a major cargo hub in the country’s east.

title: Turkey Delays Black Sea Ship Access After Surge in Attacks
title_cn: 袭击激增后土耳其推迟黑海船只进入
summary: Turkey is restricting some commercial ship traffic into the Black Sea, according to people familiar with the matter, following growing concern from the government over an uptick in Russian and Ukrainian attacks on vessels in the area.

title: Senate Confirms Former Trump Defense Lawyer as AG
title_cn: 参议院确认前特朗普辩护律师担任总检察长
summary: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as Attorney General despite initial opposition from multiple senators concerned about Blanche's ties to President Trump. A deal was struck in the early hours to secure enough votes with key holdouts such as Senator Bill Cassidy changing his position. Bloomberg News Washington Deputy Bureau Chief Laura Davison joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the tense and closely watched process. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Magyar’s Party Names Former Chief Justice for Hungary President
title_cn: 马扎尔党任命前首席大法官为匈牙利总统
summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s party named former Supreme Court justice Andras Baka as its new candidate to assume the office of president following last month’s ouster of Tamas Sulyok.

title: Senate Passes Funding Bill That Ignores Trump’s Priorities
title_cn: 参议院通过忽视特朗普优先事项的拨款法案
summary: The US Senate passed a short-term spending bill to avert a damaging government shutdown weeks before the November midterms, sidestepping President Donald Trump’s calls to also enact emergency funds for the Iran war and elements of a controversial voter identification proposal.

title: Todd Blanche Confirmed by Senate as Trump’s Attorney General
title_cn: 托德·布兰奇被参议院确认为特朗普的司法部长
summary: The US Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as attorney general, elevating President Donald Trump’s one-time personal defense lawyer to lead the nation’s top federal law enforcement agency.
